the design, implementation and testing of a Job Submission Web service that is DRM-neutral, and is based on standard technologies.
the development of an interoperable, DRM- neutral job submission service, which is accessible through a standardised Web Service interface.

the use of standardised Web Service specifications and related technologies provides a powerful, flexible and robust solution to job submission.
